historical_inventory.method: Python AST traversal selects Object calls whose first positional argument is the NonMatching name at the exact pre-promotion and post-promotion revisions. Retail ownership comes from the canonical objdiff report regenerated in this run.
historical_inventory.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
report=json.loads(Path('build/GEDE01/report.json').read_text())
units={u['name']:u for u in report['units']}
for label,revision in [('baseline','131d92f72^'),('post_promotion','131d92f72')]:
    text=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{revision}:eternal-darkness-decomp/configure.py'],text=True)
    calls=[n for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(text)) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id=='Object' and len(n.args)>=2 and isinstance(n.args[0],ast.Name) and n.args[0].id=='NonMatching']
    sources=[ast.literal_eval(n.args[1]) for n in calls]
    names=['main/'+s.removeprefix('src/').removesuffix('.c') for s in sources]
    missing=[name for name in names if name not in units]
    mapped=[units[name] for name in names if name in units]
    total=lambda key:sum(int(unit.get('measures',{}).get(key,0)) for unit in mapped)
    multiline=sum(call.lineno != call.args[0].lineno for call in calls)
    print(f'{label}: revision={revision} registrations={len(calls)} multiline_registrations={multiline} mapped={len(mapped)} unmapped={len(missing)} code_bytes={total("total_code")} data_bytes={total("total_data")} functions={total("total_functions")}')
    print(f'{label}_unmapped_units: '+(','.join(missing) if missing else '(none)'))
PY

missed_multiline_objects.method: The same AST identifies calls whose Object opening line differs from the NonMatching argument line. A fresh relocation-strict objdiff artifact was generated for every identified unit. The report score and direct code-section score shown below come from this run; no affected unit is fully matching.
missed_multiline_objects.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
text=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','131d92f72^:eternal-darkness-decomp/configure.py'],text=True)
calls=[n for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(text)) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id=='Object' and len(n.args)>=2 and isinstance(n.args[0],ast.Name) and n.args[0].id=='NonMatching']
affected=[ast.literal_eval(n.args[1]) for n in calls if n.lineno != n.args[0].lineno]
report=json.loads(Path('build/GEDE01/report.json').read_text())
units={u['name']:u for u in report['units']}
print(f'affected_count={len(affected)}')
fully_matching=0
for source in affected:
    unit='main/'+source.removesuffix('.c')
    stem=Path(source).stem
    output=f'build/GEDE01/session-1690-remediation-1-reissue-1-{stem}.json'
    cmd=['build/tools/objdiff-cli','diff','-p','.','-u',unit,'-o',output,'--format','json-pretty','-c','function_reloc_diffs=name_address']
    subprocess.run(cmd,check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    direct=json.loads(Path(output).read_text())
    left=[s for s in direct['left']['sections'] if s.get('kind')=='SECTION_CODE']
    right=[s for s in direct['right']['sections'] if s.get('kind')=='SECTION_CODE']
    ldesc=','.join(f"{s['name']}:{s['size']}:{s.get('match_percent','unscored')}" for s in left) or '(none)'
    rdesc=','.join(f"{s['name']}:{s['size']}:{s.get('match_percent','unscored')}" for s in right) or '(none)'
    score=units[unit]['measures']['fuzzy_match_percent']
    fully_matching += score == 100.0
    print(f'unit={unit} report_fuzzy_match_percent={score} left_code={ldesc} right_code={rdesc} artifact={output}')
print(f'fully_matching_affected_count={fully_matching}')
PY
